title: External synchronization option for the plasma notes applet
line: Sticky notes can now be kept in a file you choose, such as one in a Nextcloud or Syncthing folder, so the same note shows up on several computers.
explanation: Sticky Notes always stored each note in a private file under ~/.local/share/plasma_notes, with no way to point it anywhere else, so a note could not be shared between computers or with other apps. The change adds a Sync page to the note's settings with a "Keep note in file" field and file picker. When a file is set, the note reads and saves that file instead, watches it for changes made by sync clients or other notes, and fills a new or empty file with the note's current text; plain-text files written by other programs are shown with their line breaks.

commits.message:
applets/notes: allow keeping a note in a file of your choice

Notes could only live in a private folder, so there was no way to share
one between computers. A new Sync page lets you pick a file, for example
in a Nextcloud or Syncthing folder, which the note then reads and saves.

BUG: 417165
